messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00000: Welcome to the Battle Hall!\rI am your guide to the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rPlease be aware that these challenges\nare designed for a single Trainer.\r
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00001: Which challenge would you\nlike to take?{YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00002:
At the Battle Hall, you may take Single
or Double Battle challenges alone.For the Single Battle challenge, you
enter one Pokémon of at least Lv. 30.The Double Battle Challenge requires
you to enter two of the same kind of Pokémon that are at least Lv. 30 each.Winning-streak records are kept for
individual kinds of Pokémon.That makes it possible for any kind of
Pokémon to aim for no. 1.When you enter the Hall, you will be
asked to choose the type and rank of the Pokémon you want to battle.If you manage to win ten matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Please be aware of that!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00003: Welcome to the Battle Hall!\rI am your guide to the Multi Battle\nchallenge.\rPlease be aware that this challenge\nrequires two Trainers.\r
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00004: Would you like to take the Battle\nHall Multi Battle challenge? {YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00005:
You may team up with a friend for a
Multi Battle challenge using the same kind of Pokémon that are at least Lv. 30 each.When you enter the Hall, you will be
asked to choose the type and rank of the Pokémon you want to battle.If you manage to win ten matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).Please note: a Battle Hall Multi Battle
challenge can’t be interrupted.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00006: We hope to see you again!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00007: Which challenge level would you like to\nplay? Level 50 or Open Level?
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00008: You must save the game before\nI show you in. Is that OK?{YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00010: We look forward to your next visit.\r

messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00024: Want to raise strong Pokémon\nbut have no clue which one to pick...?\rFor those Trainers who feel this way,\nthe Battle Factory is truly a place\fworth visiting!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00025: You are quite right.\rThey say life is an endless series of\nlearning opportunities.\rThis place is the best for learning\nabout Pokémon battles and about\fother Trainers...
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00026: Aaaaand--bam!\nAaaaaaaaaand--bam!\rI don’t have Pokémon yet, so I’m\npracticing throwing Poké Balls!

messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00057: The Battle Hall Multi Battle challenge\nrequires both partners to enter the\fsame kind of Pokémon.\rPlease confer with your friend and\nchoose the same kind of Pokémon.\r
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00059:
Do you eat your favorite dish first or
leave it for later?At the Battle Hall, it’s better to start
with the types that your Pokémon do not like. Why?Because the opposition goes up in
level as you progress!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00060: That opulent stage!\rYour streaks of winnings are kept per\neach kind of Pokémon.\fEvery Pokémon can get up there.\rDon’t you think it’s wonderful\nyou can aim for the top with\fany Pokémon?
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00061: Slow...\rMy SLOWBRO is a cutie, but he’s even\nbattled the Brain here.\rThe Brain will take your Pokémon on at\nthe same level, to be fair.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00063: Here is a tip!\rYou should try the Battle Hall with\nnot just your favorite Pokémon,\rbut different kinds of Pokémon\nif you want to build your\foverall record as well.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00064: At the Battle Hall, if it’s the same kind\nof Pokémon, you can enter different\fones and still keep your record.\rYou may want to have different ones\nknowing different types of moves.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00065:
You know how HOPPIP has two types--
Grass and Flying?That means it can appear as a
Grass type and as a Flying type.Me?You could think of me as...
a “Lighthearted” type and a “Beautiful” type, I guess.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00066: A piece of advice...\rAt the Battle Hall, the opposing\nPokémon are matched in level to yours.\rThat way, you can choose any of your\nPokémon without worrying about\ftheir levels.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00067: The Battle Hall lets you keep the\nwinning-streak records.\fThat’s neat, huh?\r...Wait a sec!\rMy friend and I can start challenges\nwith identical conditions and see who\fcan stretch their win streak\fthe longest.\fThat’s even more fun!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00068: I keep track of the total number of\nwins from your longest Single Battle\fwin streaks at the Battle Hall.\rTo explain, I add only the longest win\nstreaks of each kind of Pokémon.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00069: When your total win-streak record hits\ncertain figures, you will earn BP as\fa reward.\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your total win-streak\nrecord is presently {STRVAR_1 55, 1, 0}.\r

messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00074: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your total win-streak\nrecord stands at {STRVAR_1 55, 1, 0}.\r...My goodness!\nThat’s a fantastic record!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00075:
Winston: The Battle Hall’s been kind of
boring lately.There haven’t been any dazzling
challengers who can electrify crowds.The kind of challenger who can beat the
Brain... Aren’t there any around?
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00076: Winston: Let me take a wild guess.\nAre you getting into the Battle Hall?\fIt’s addictively fun, huh?\rThe more you win, the more kinds of\nPokémon you get to see, too.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00077:
Winston: ...
...Oh, sorry for staring!I saw you on stage the last time.
You’ve got some star quality.I think I’m going to keep an eye on you.
There’s real charisma there.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00078: Winston: I check you out every time\nyou get up on stage.\rYou’re fun to watch, let me tell you.\rNow I’m always looking forward to\nseeing the combo of you and your\fPokémon on stage.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00079:
Winston: Hey, there!
What are you going to do this time?Which Pokémon are you going for a
record with next?When I get to thinking about that,
I get too wound up to sleep at night.That’s why I’ve been sleeping in lately!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00080: Winston: Awesome!\nSeriously awesome!\fYou’re beyond awesome, even!\rThe love you show so many Pokémon...\nIt’s no easy feat, I can tell ya!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00081:
Winston: I’ve never seen Pokémon
battle as enjoyably as yours do.You’re the first of a kind for me as
Trainers go.You know, I brag about you to everyone
who’s willing to listen.I was saying that you’re going to be a
star before you even got a record!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00082:
Winston: Go, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, go!
Go, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, go!I’m thinking up some dance steps and
cheers I can do to support you.If you want to see them, you’ll need to
keep working on your records!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00083: Winston: You’re phenomenal.\nAll the battles you waged on stage...\fAll those moments of glory...\rYour star burns so bright and huge!\nI can barely open my eyes around you!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00084:
Winston: The love for Pokémon you
exhibited at the Battle Hall is as infinitely deep as it is wide...You can count on me, Winston, to be
your lifelong fan.Just as you love Pokémon, I love you
as the Pokémon superstar!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00085:
Serena: It’s about the Battle Hall...
It hasn’t excited me lately.There’s been no gorgeous sort of
challenger who can dazzle me.The kind of challenger who can make me
a fan... Aren’t there any around?
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00086:
Serena: Um... Excuse me?If you don’t mind me asking, are you
getting into the Battle Hall?It’s fun in an engrossing way, isn’t it?
Did you know?The more you win, the more kinds of
Pokémon appear.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00087: Serena: Um... Excuse me?\rI watched you when you were on stage.\nIt made me feel all tingly seeing you.\rUm... You won’t mind if I cheer for you\nfrom now on, will you? Please, may I?
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00088: Serena: Um... Excuse me?\rI cheer for you the best I can.\rI can’t get up on stage with you, but\nI want to lend my support to your\fPokémon and you for trying so hard.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00089:
Serena: Um... Excuse me?Can you tell me what kind of Pokémon
you’re going for a record with next?When I start thinking about that, I get
sort of all choked up.I have trouble sleeping at night when
I get that way.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00090: Serena: Um... Excuse me?\rFantastic! It’s fantastic!\nYou’re fabulously fantastic!\rThe love you show so many Pokémon...\nIt must take extraordinary effort.
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00091:
Serena: I’ve never seen Pokémon
battle as enjoyably as yours do.You’re the first Trainer ever who’s
done that.I... I brag about you to all my friends.
I hope you don’t mind.I tell them I wish I could be as
wonderful a Trainer as you!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00092:
Serena: Hurray, hurray, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
Go, Pokémon, go!...Oh! Um... Excuse me.I was working on cheers and a dance
routine for you.B-but, I’m sorry for being so silly and
giddy and...
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00093: Serena: You’re so inspiring to me.\rAll the glory you earned while battling\nso often on that shining stage...\rJust seeing you makes me feel all\nhappy inside. ♫
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00094:
Serena: Your Pokémon love that you’ve
shown at the Battle Hall is as infinitely deep as it is wide...It’s amazing, but you love every kind of
Pokémon there is.I love you for being so amazing and
dedicated!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00095: Lyra: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\nI love watching you battle here.\rCause...\nyou have fun whether you win\for lose!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00096: Ethan: The Battle Hall is great for\nPokémon fans like me!\rI get to see so many new kinds of\nPokémon I’ve never seen.\rIt’s so cool!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00097: Mom: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rI couldn’t help checking up on you!\rEveryone is working hard, but I have\nto say you look more delighted than\fanyone else!\rOh, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, that’s right!\rI should go to the Department Store\nin Goldenrod and buy some useful\fitems for you on the way home!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00098:
Professor Oak: You keep amazing me
over and over again.What a Trainer you turned out to be!It’s not enough that you caught
Pokémon in numbers beyond belief.That alone is fantastic enough.
But you’ve bonded and battled with them as well.I am so proud to know you!
messages.msg_0108_D32R0401_00099:
Whitney: I love showy events like
the Battle Hall.I’m not saying that I want to stand out
in the crowd...I just love seeing cute Pokémon
getting lots of attention!
